questions.context:
-- Event yang belum diterapkan per replica
SELECT r.replica_name, ev.gtid, ev.event, ev.payload
FROM replica_state r
JOIN binlog ev ON ev.gtid > r.applied_gtid
ORDER BY r.replica_name, ev.gtid;

-- Kesehatan replikasi: behind tinggi = risiko data stale
SELECT replica_name,
       applied_gtid AS applied,
       (SELECT MAX(gtid) FROM binlog) - applied_gtid AS behind,
       lag_seconds
FROM replica_state
ORDER BY behind DESC;

questions.q: Apa BARIS TERAKHIR hasil query berikut? (jalankan mental, lalu cek!)
questions.context:
SELECT bulan, produk, revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY produk ORDER BY bulan) AS prev_revenue,
    revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY produk ORDER BY bulan) AS perubahan
    FROM penjualan ORDER BY produk, bulan;

SELECT bulan, produk, revenue,
    SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY produk ORDER BY bulan) AS running_total
    FROM penjualan ORDER BY produk, bulan;

SELECT bulan, produk, revenue,
    AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY produk ORDER BY bulan
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg
    FROM penjualan ORDER BY produk, bulan;

questions.q: What is the LAST ROW returned by the following query?
questions.context:
SELECT bulan, produk, revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY produk ORDER BY bulan) AS prev_revenue,
    revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY produk ORDER BY bulan) AS perubahan
    FROM penjualan ORDER BY produk, bulan;

SELECT bulan, produk, revenue,
    SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY produk ORDER BY bulan) AS running_total
    FROM penjualan ORDER BY produk, bulan;

SELECT bulan, produk, revenue,
    AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY produk ORDER BY bulan
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg
    FROM penjualan ORDER BY produk, bulan;
